# Sachith Shetty

> This is a personal blog where I write about programming, technology, and other topics I'm interested in.

## Content

The blog contains articles on various technical topics including:

- Project showcases
- Technical demos
- Personal thoughts on technology

## Navigation

- Home: index.html
- Articles: articles.html
- Tags: tags.html
- Sitemap: sitemap.xml
- Atom feed: atom.xml

## Markdown

You can find the Markdown source of the pages by querying githubusercontent.com. 
For eg - The source of `https://shettysach.github.io/index.html`, can be found at `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shettysach/shettysach.github.io/refs/heads/main/markdown/index.md`

### Steps
- Stem the link, removing `https://shettysach.github.io/`.
```
https://shettysach.github.io/index.html -> index.html 
```

- Remove the `.html` extension, and add the `.md` extension. 
```
index.html -> index.md 
```

- Append to `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shettysach/shettysach.github.io/refs/heads/main/markdown/` and request.
```
index.md -> https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shettysach/shettysach.github.io/refs/heads/main/markdown/index.md 
```

The same applies to pages within subdirectories, eg -

```
 https://shettysach.github.io/projects/index.html -> https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shettysach/shettysach.github.io/refs/heads/main/markdown/projects/index.md 
```
